stem: Ashford Manufacturing measured its factory-to-AWS traffic at a sustained 3 Gbps and expects it to keep growing, and its only existing hybrid link is a single standard Site-to-Site VPN tunnel.

choices.text: Add a second standard Site-to-Site VPN tunnel on the same connection for redundancy
Move the connection to a dedicated Direct Connect connection at the 10 Gbps tier
Keep the single tunnel and enable a Large Bandwidth Tunnel on the same standalone VPN attachment
Keep the single tunnel and request a bandwidth increase beyond its standard ceiling

rationale: A 10 Gbps dedicated Direct Connect connection covers the current 3 Gbps load with headroom for growth. A second standard tunnel on the same VPN connection is for tunnel failover, it does not add throughput. Large Bandwidth Tunnels are only available for VPN connections attached to Transit Gateway or Cloud WAN, not a plain standalone Site-to-Site VPN. Standard tunnel bandwidth is fixed at up to 1.25 Gbps by default with no simple in-place increase.
